Fixtures for the scheme parser.

- base24-current.yaml: tinted-theming/schemes base24/tokyo-night-dark.yaml

- base16-flat.yaml and base24-flat.yaml: the same two schemes rewritten by hand

  files in tinted-theming/base16-schemes (e.g. 3024.yaml).
